def url_from(location)
  location = location.presence
  location if location && _url_host_allowed?(location)

class SessionsController < ApplicationController
  allow_unauthenticated_access only: %i[ new create ]

      start_new_session_for user
      redirect_to return_to_url || post_authenticating_url
    else
      render_rejection :unauthorized
    end
  end

    terminate_current_session
    redirect_to root_url
  end

    def ensure_user_exists
      redirect_to first_run_url if User.none?
    end

      location = params[:return_to]
      return unless location.is_a?(String) && location.valid_encoding? && !location.match?(/[\x00-\x20\x7f]/)

      if url = url_from(location)
        uri = URI.parse(url)
        url if valid_return_to_uri?(uri)

    def valid_return_to_uri?(uri)
      if uri.host.nil?
        uri.scheme.nil? && uri.userinfo.nil? && uri.port.nil?
      else
        uri.is_a?(URI::HTTP) && uri.userinfo.nil? &&
          (uri.port == request.port || (request.standard_port? && uri.port == uri.default_port))
      end
    end

    def render_rejection(status)
      flash[:alert] = "Too many requests or unauthorized."
      render :new, status: status
    end
end
